description: Agent loop settings shared by all three agents. max_tool_calls: the most tool calls the model may make while answering one prompt; 0 means no limit (a model stuck in a loop then runs until stopped with Ctrl+C). A multi-step task (read a project, change it, build, open a merge request) needs 20 or more. memory_index: the agents' memory index (relative to the repository), loaded into their instructions at start-up; the memory tool maintains it.
